A few helpful details

Before we begin.

How do I book an appointment?

Fill in the appointment section and continue to WhatsApp, or message +91 70214 10676 directly. The team will discuss a suitable time and confirm your appointment.

Can I discuss just one room?

Yes. The business lists modular kitchens, TV units, beds, wardrobes, doors and false ceilings alongside home and office interiors. Tell the team what you have in mind.

How much will my interiors cost?

The scope, measurements, materials and finishes affect your estimate. Share your requirements and budget on WhatsApp to discuss a quote with the team.

Where are you located?

Visit Pawandham, 05, Gandhari Road, West, Khadakpada, Kalyan, Maharashtra 421301. Please call or message before visiting to confirm availability and current opening hours.
